newsitem.title: USA: Trigen files lawsuit against Okla. utility.
newsitem.headline: Trigen files lawsuit against Okla. utility.

text.p: Trigen Energy Corp said on Wednesday that it filed an antitrust suit against Oklahoma Gas & Electric Co.
Trigen's suit alleges that Oklahoma Gas has illegally used its monopoly power as an electric utility to compete unfairly against Trigen in an unregulated business area, the company said.
Oklahoma Gas could not be reached for comment.
Trigen said the lawsuit was filed today in U.S. District Court and is seeking damages of $21 million.
Trigen contends in its lawsuit that Oklahoma Gas is seeking to destroy Trigen before the companies compete in deregulated electrical markets.
